liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wave To The Wind** (2 reviews): Wave To The Wind is described as a train wreck with excessive chords; Wave To The Wind is a train wreck with too many chords [11][16]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song is a good performance worthy of its position in the set [21]
- **Space** (1 review): The reviewer highlights the Space performance as a definite highlight of the show [10]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): The second set is average except for a good Throwing Stones jam [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-03-13.134996.bltz.flac2496** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd92-03-13.nak700.gardner.9477.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 151 min; rated 2.54/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Mickey and Billy transformed Nassau Coliseum into a giant freight-train tunnel; The first set was good, and the recording sound is pretty good; The recording sounds much better on tape than it did live [10][13][20]
- **gd1992-03-13.155831.FOBSchoepsMasterDAT.BrotmanMetchickAnonNoel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 156 min [3]
- **gd1992-03-13.148351.fob.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 156 min [4]

## Around the show

- A crazy horn during Space initially made the listener think a China Rider was coming [12]
- It was cold and rainy outside, and the listener stayed at Howard Johnson [13]
- Kruetzman walked out with a huge horn strapped to his chest during the show [17]
- The train horn was so loud the listener hit the floor in fear [17]
- The listener traveled from Hampton to Philly with their dog Mabel in a microbus [19]
- The train horn blew everyone away, followed by a closing Box of Rain [19]
- The energy was dull and slow, with heads sitting throughout the first set [20]
- A shocking train horn during Space foreshadowed a later Casey Jones breakout [1]
- The show was certainly below average compared to other performances [16]
- The show was mellow and lackluster compared to the previous night's performance [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-03-13.134996.bltz.flac2496**: taped by bltz; transferred by bltz; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-300s/2-Mic, CP-1 Cardioids, ORTF -> Sony Walkman Pro, Maxell MX-S 100 Cassette Tape -> JVC TD-W354 -> Zoom H6 96/24 WAV -> Audacity ->… [1]. Also: This may be the last show the uploader saw or recorded with Jerry [1]
- **gd92-03-13.nak700.gardner.9477.sbeok.shnf**: source: ACM>DAT>CDR (Nak 700Âs>Sony D-3) [2]. Also: The second set shn files were downloaded to complement a first set video; The Space shn file incorrectly includes The Wheel, which is also separate [18]
- **gd1992-03-13.155831.FOBSchoepsMasterDAT.BrotmanMetchickAnonNoel.t-flac1648**: taped by Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer by Anonymous Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel January 16, 2022; source: Recording: FOB Schoeps CMC34 (ORTF) > Tao Research > M1000 cables > Panasonic SV-255mod (16/48) > Master DAT Location: 18th Row Center [3]
- **gd1992-03-13.148351.fob.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB B&K 4011-> DAT [4]
